market.title: Starship: Humans to Mars Before 2030
resolutionNote: Kalshi's own wording: "If SpaceX launches a manned Starship mission to Mars by Dec 31, 2029, then the market resolves to Yes."

This is the crewed-mission-specific contract - don't confuse it with Kalshi's separate "Will SpaceX land anything successfully on Mars before 2030?" market, which also counts uncrewed landings and has traded notably higher (around 27-31%, vs. roughly 17% here).
No confirmed Polymarket market with matching crewed-by-2030 resolution criteria was found, so this page is Kalshi-only.

text: SpaceX owner Elon Musk has repeatedly asserted that Mars is the next frontier, including a July X post declaring 'it's time' for humanity to become multiplanetary.
In SpaceX's Nasdaq IPO prospectus, Mars appears 63 times, although there has been no confirmed timeline for missions to the planet.
Starship, the spacecraft in development by SpaceX, has seen significant progress, including an intact heat shield and a soft splashdown in its test flight on July 24.
Of course, a crewed mission to Mars is a much more difficult bet than SpaceX landing anything on Mars, which has climbed to around 29% amid continued optimism after Starship's 13th test flight.
The price descended in August as Elon Musk extended the timeline for humans on Mars to 2031-2033 and Starship missed multiple launch deadlines.
